title: Ben 10 Reboot
description: With the fifth offshoot of the “Ben 10” franchise, the animated series returns to its roots and its original name, bringing teenager Benjamin “Ben” Tennyson, his cousin Gwen and Grandpa Max back to life on a new summer vacation journey. As in the original, the stories in the remake of the series also spin around an alien wristwatch called “Omnitrix,” with the help of Ben can turn into ten different friendly aliens, which come up with different supernatural powers. He fights enemy aliens and experiences with grandfather and cousin the most exciting vacation imaginable.Please Note That Episode Numbers and Name Will not Match Because Episode List is Imported From TheMovieDatabse But Episodes are Ripped From Amazon Prime (Different Order)

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x1
episodes_data.description: Ben is tasked with cleaning the Rust Bucket, but when he is tricked into letting the villainous and vile Fly Guys steal it, he must chase them down before they create an unstoppable maggot monster.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x2
episodes_data.description: Ben, Gwen, and Max's trip to Niagara Falls is cut short by the horrid Hydromanders - creatures menacing them and their fellow tourists.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x3
episodes_data.description: Ben and Gwen's camping trip is interrupted by the emotionless Weatherheads - Gust-o, Hail-o, & Shock-o - but a malfunctioning Omnitrix firing out a mishmash of aliens may not be the forecast for success.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x4
episodes_data.description: Ben and Gwen's camping trip is interrupted by the emotionless Weatherheads - Gust-o, Hail-o, & Shock-o - but a malfunctioning Omnitrix firing out a mishmash of aliens may not be the forecast for success.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x5
episodes_data.description: Ben must overcome his fear of squids when the Steampunk super villain Steam Smythe attacks a construction site of Grandpa Max's favorite pier.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x6
episodes_data.description: While trying to film his own indie film, Ben accidentally allows the Bug Gang to go free and when he takes the fight to their hidden lair, Ben has to take on their narcissistic leader - the Ant Queen.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x7
episodes_data.description: Ben and Gwen are turned into babies by a weird nanny who wants to turn the world into a day care.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x8
episodes_data.description: While chilling at a monastery with a no-noise policy, Ben can't keep quiet and accidentally awakens a dangerous Dragon hidden in a secret chamber below the hallowed halls - a job that might be too much for even Diamondhead.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x9
episodes_data.description: When a wizard cos player gets his hands on a real magic wand at Comic Con, Ben enlists the help of Gwen (as Lucky Girl) to help stop Hex from retrieving it by tricking the wicked warlock into thinking she is a possessor of powerful magic herself.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x10
episodes_data.description: Ben stumbles into Dr. Animo's secret lab - now ruled by his superior mutants, the Alphas - and must help the lesser animals escape while stuck as Stinkfly.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x11
episodes_data.description: While tailgating at a State U. homecoming football game, Ben teams up with Grandpa Max's old college buddies to keep the crazy clown Zombozo from robbing the stadium blind at halftime.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x12
episodes_data.description: Gwen, Ben and Max encounter a family who are kind of their mirror selves.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x13
episodes_data.description: The Tennysons visit Fort Know, but it does not last long till Ben has to fight a monster.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x14
episodes_data.description: In the heart of Silicon Valley, Ben has to stop Victorian villain, Steam Smythe, from getting an incredible power source sealed in a Tesla time capsule.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x15
episodes_data.description: Dr. Animo returns with his newest invention, the 'Animerger'.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x16
episodes_data.description: No one believes Ben when he insists that one of the other patrons, waiting in line at the World of Wet Water Park, is the nefarious Frightwig, disguised as a common girl called Frida.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x17
episodes_data.description: A man attempting to be a hero ends up misusing his abilities, and Ben has to stop him.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x18
episodes_data.description: Ben and Gwen decide to race against LaGrange when he crashes a race.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x19
episodes_data.description: The group visit the Buddy's Vision Of Tomorrow exhibit, where Steam Smythe hopes to take a secret weapon to rule the world.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x20
episodes_data.description: Hex returns for the large spellbook Grimoire of Archamada which contains a high-level spell that will make him more powerful than ever.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 1x21
episodes_data.description: While golfing, Ben must face a biker gang of mutated groundhogs.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x1
episodes_data.description: On a visit to Cape Canaveral, the Tennyson Trio attend the launch of an experimental space plane, but when Vilgax hijacks the ship, Ben must stop him from weaponizing the shuttle.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x2
episodes_data.description: After stumbling upon a cute cat-dog-rabbit creature hybrid, or Cadobbit, Ben ignores Grandpa Max's advice and sneaks the animal onto the Rust Bucket.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x3
episodes_data.description: During the Biggie Box sale, Ben enlists Simon Sez to help him find Max and get back to the register with his toys before the sale ends and Billy Billions buys them instead.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x4
episodes_data.description: Aboard the SS Pettigrew, on its final voyage, Ben must not only battle seasickness, but Steam Smythe, who looks to use his mechanical creatures to sink the steamship's replacement.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x5
episodes_data.description: After their attempt to get a photo with every storefront mascot is foiled, Ben and Gwen sneak out at night to get their photo taken with the wooden bear totem known as Yawk.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x6
episodes_data.description: When a cavity forces Ben to the dentist, his day gets even worse when the malevolent magician Hex uses a nearby dream catcher to bring Ben's fears to life.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x7
episodes_data.description: When the Rust Bucket must tune-up in the same town as Zombozo's latest campaign trail stop, Ben soon discovers the clown is using his speeches to hypnotize then rob the town.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x8
episodes_data.description: As the Tennyson trio dig up dinosaur fossils in the Badlands, Ben is unaware that Vilgax and Dr. Amino have teamed up to steal alien DNA from within the Omnitrix.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x9
episodes_data.description: Ben is trying to save a city from a mudslide when Vilgax shows up with a warning about a new alien coming out of Omnitrix.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x10
episodes_data.description: The new alien has dangerous powers, and that worries Ben more and more.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x11
episodes_data.description: During a live feed of a transcontinental bullet train, La Grange enters the picture to outrace the train, but Ben joins in on the fun and will stop at nothing to come out on top.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x12
episodes_data.description: Ben and Gwen must save the drive-in when the evil magician Hex brings a movie monster to life.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x13
episodes_data.description: Ben and Gwen are in a highly competitive paper airplane war, but when alien-tech drones bombard the Rust Bucket, the cousins must work together to ground the aerial attack

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x14
episodes_data.description: On their trip to Adrenaworld West, Ben takes a detour on a jungle cruise and finds himself hunted by the evil Tim Buktu.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x15
episodes_data.description: While sightseeing at the Geyser Gulch National Park, the Tennyson trio uncovers Steam Smythe's steam-powered generator and must shut it down before it overloads the power grid.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x16
episodes_data.description: When Max enters a pancake eating contest at the famous Pancake Palace, Ben finds the Bugg Brothers and must stop them before they obtain an endless supply of Pancake Palace pancakes.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x17
episodes_data.description: During a routine trip to the DMV, Max takes a driving test to renew his license, but a disguised Zombozo hijacks the role of instructor.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x18
episodes_data.description: Ben and Gwen volunteer for a day at the Repto Ranch. There they meet the evil King Koil, who takes control of the reptiles in the facility to create an army. Both of them must overcome their fear of snakes and save the animals that the King Koil has released

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x19
episodes_data.description: As Team Tennyson leaves the Frozen Man Festival, Lord Decibel takes center stage to threaten the festival-goers, creating an avalanche if his ransom isn't paid.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x20
episodes_data.description: When Ben grows impatient with the snail like pace of gardening, he goes Omni-Enhaanced Overflow to pick up the pace and accidentally floods the community rock garden. But once a giant sink hole appears and frees King Koil and his Kimodo Dragon from below, Ben must quickly make up for his mistake and capture the baddies if he is to save the coastal city of Bayburgh.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x21
episodes_data.description: Ben, Gwen and Grandpa Max stop in the middle of the Midwest. While Ben makes himself comfortable in the mobile home with his tablet, Max and Gwen go outside to get some fresh air. When Gwen and Max are drawn into the hunt for a Jackalope, a mythical animal that looks like a rabbit with antlers, the mysterious animal soon starts tormenting Ben. But is it real or a trick of Ben's tablet-ladden mind?

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x22
episodes_data.description: A mysterious alien substance copies Ben's appearance and powers while Ben is visiting a space museum, and quickly assumes the shape of other people, leaving the Tennysons to find a way to reveal who is actually the mysterious substance. Note: This episode is a parody of The Thing.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 2x23
episodes_data.description: During a trip to the Lake of the Ozarks, Ben and Gwen squabble over Ben's unnecessary half-birthday celebration; when Max gets word of a suspicious rockslide nearby, the cousins must put aside their differences if they are to rescue trapped miners.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x1
episodes_data.description: When Grandpa Max’s engineer buddy Phil Billings gifts Team Tennyson the Omni-Copter, a state of the art flying vehicle that can transport the Rustbucket for overseas adventures, Steam Smythe takes to the skies to ground Ben and company’s first test flight; but unbeknownst to our heroes, Smythe was sent to battle Ben’s latest alien forms by a mysterious, powerful enemy: the Forever Knight.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x2
episodes_data.description: During one last stop by a toy store before Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max's maiden voyage across the Atlantic, Ben runs into an old bully, Kevin 11, who now has new powers. He's able to transform into aliens just like Ben, such as the "bootleg" doppelganger of Cannon-bolt—Wrecking-bolt!

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x3
episodes_data.description: Back stateside, Ben can't get into a cat cosplay competition, Top Tail, without a cat costume of his own; but when he goes Rath, a new cat-like alien with an attitude, Ben's newfound wild side quickly becomes much more than he bargained for, and must learn to hold in his rage.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x4
episodes_data.description: When Ben, Gwen, and Max try to travel to the South Pole, magnetic disturbances cause the instruments to malfunction and take them to the North Pole instead, where they find that two criminal scientist brothers, Polar and Solar Twain, have plans to swap the magnetic poles of the Earth, unleashing technologic and atmospheric disturbance unless the world pays a ransom.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x5
episodes_data.description: Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max arrive at a Native American park to see the Ayasha Plinths, an ancient Stonehenge-like rock formation. But when Hex arrives, he casts a spell that causes everyone to interpret what he says as a lie, turning Hex into a hero planning on creating the Golem of Ayasha.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x6
episodes_data.description: During medieval times, Team Tennyson must fight to remember that they're not in the past at all, but actually at a Renaissance-ques fair, where Zombozo has hypnotized its guests into thinking they live in the past.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x7
episodes_data.description: After an overpass collapses on the highway, Team Tennyson is trapped in a traffic jam along with Simon Sez and his family. But when Ben and Simon team up to tackle the gridlock together, Simon only makes matters worse.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x8
episodes_data.description: After traveling to Tampa Beach, Florida, Team Tennyson hopes to get some much-needed rest & relaxation, but the Weatherheads have other plans that Ben must thwart: a solar powered tower so that they never worry about losing power.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x9
episodes_data.description: During a family cookout at a forest campsite, Charmcaster uses her magic to switch places with Gwen, but when Ben catches "Charmcaster" sneaking about, he attacks, unaware it's actually his cursed cousin.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x10
episodes_data.description: In Aspen, Colorado, Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max are on a hike to find the Forgeti, but when they realize they've stumbled upon Billy Billions own "Winter in July" ski resort, Ben must battle Billy, with an assist from the Forgeti itself.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x11
episodes_data.description: Ben and Gwen's recreational drive in the Rustbuggy takes a turn when Glitch bonds with part of Kevin 11's version of 'Upgrade' named Bootleg. Not only does this cause the Rustbuggy to mutate into a metallic monster, but it makes Glitch become a speed demon who kidnaps Gwen!

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x12
episodes_data.description: Team Tennyson wonders what the Bugg Brothers are up to when the group runs into them while vacationing at the Chrysalen Institute.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x13
episodes_data.description: After a battle with Kevin gets cut short, Ben turns his attention to one-upping Gwen at Space Camp. But, when Kevin returns with his sights strangely set on his cousin, our hero discovers who is really behind it all: Charmcaster!

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x14
episodes_data.description: When attacked in the jungle, Team Tennyson is saved by a toddler who looks eerily similar to Tim Buktu, but when they discover it really a pint sized version of the nefarious globetrotter, Ben knows there's another threat looming: Nanny Nightmare.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x15
episodes_data.description: Team Tennyson discovers a Hartfield-McJoy (a parody of the Hatfield-McCoy feud) reenactment in the cornfield next door, but when Hex resurrects the ghosts of the real feuding families, Ben must find a way to bring them together in order to save the day.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x16
episodes_data.description: While Phil and Grandpa Max tune-up the Omni-Copter, Ben takes the Rustbuggy off road, but when he is suddenly captured by Tetrax, our hero must not only escape but avoid the wrath of the double-crossed Kraab and Sixsix!

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x17
episodes_data.description: Team Tennyson discovers that a small village's goats are being terrorized by the legendary Chupacabra, but when Ben realizes it's actually Dr. Animo, our hero must thwart the dastardly doctor.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x18
episodes_data.description: After winning a Sumo Slammers Champion belt, Ben returns to the Rustbucket to find it in the arms of Kevin, but when his rival hijacks the Rustbuggy instead, our hero must stop at nothing to get back what belongs to him. Eventually, though, Kevin and Ben must work together to fend off an attack from the Forever Knight, who is angered at Kevin's refusal to follow orders.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x19
episodes_data.description: At a local swap meet, Ben instead sets his sights on a Sumo Slammer collectible, but when Kevin takes it for himself, our hero must get it back by overcoming Kevin's secret weapon: an 11th alien named Bashmouth.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x20
episodes_data.description: During their visit to the Twin City, Ben and Gwen sign up for some Laser Town awesomeness, but when Ben is teamed up with Kevin, the two must overcome their differences if they are to end up on top, especially since Gwen has been paired with the mysterious Fang. To make things worse, a hit from a laser causes Kevin to be trapped in the form of his version of Four Arms named "Quad Smack", and he needs to find a way to fix his Antitrix in order to change back.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x21
episodes_data.description: When Team Tennyson's trip takes them to Scotland, they plan on visiting the various locales of Scotland, but their plans are foiled when the Fogg returns to exact its revenge.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x22
episodes_data.description: Team Tennyson finds out about their British ancestry, so they visit their relative's estate, but mysterious events convince Ben that the place is haunted. However, it turns out that Kevin Levin has followed them to Britain, and showcases three new alien forms based on those Ben has lost: Thornblade (Wildvine), Undertow (Overflow), and Dark Matter (Grey Matter).

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x23
episodes_data.description: When Ben and the others take a trip to Paris, Ben, impatient and uninterested, accidentally gets himself locked out of the Omni-Copter. To make things worse, he can't communicate with the people of France, and Ben ends up in the clutches of Zombozo, who hypnotizes him into being unable to speak.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x24
episodes_data.description: Team Tennyson checks out a Samurai Museum in Tokyo. However, Ben finally comes face-to-face with the Forever Knight when he steals a valuable sword from the museum and starts a chase across the rooftops.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x25
episodes_data.description: Tim Buktu returns, seemingly reformed after saving people from a dragon in the streets of Tokyo. But the Tennysons suspect there's more to Tim's actions than meets the eye.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x26
episodes_data.description: In front of a biggie box in Japan, Ben waits in an eternally long line for the release of Cyber Slammers, the brand new Sumo Slammers video game. Soon Ben has to save the whole store - and not in front of the gaming enthusiastic customers, but before Steam Smythe, who wants to equip a big Mech-suit with Steam Punk powers.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x27
episodes_data.description: While Ben and his family visit the Big Ben Clock tower, the Bugg Brothers once again set up a crazy plan: they want to shrink Big Ben's bell to steal it!

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x28
episodes_data.description: Ben, Gwen and Grandpa Max walk along the Great Wall of China, but almost have their adventure spoiled by racers LaGrange and Vin Ethanol, who want to try a daredevil jump over the wall.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x29
episodes_data.description: When a mysterious electrical storm downs the Omni-Copter at the Equator, Team Tennyson soon discovers Solar & Polar are behind it, but when Ben accidentally combines the two into a more powerful Uni-Twin, our hero must think fast if he is going to save the planet.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x30
episodes_data.description: While taking in the sights and sounds of a Rio de Jenaro music festival, Ben bristles at Gwen's suggestion that she be his new sidekick, but when the festival is threaten by the strong supersonic waves of Lord Decibel, our hero must lean on help from Gwen and Max in order to defeat him.

episodes_data.title: Ben 10 Reboot 3x31
episodes_data.description: Forever Knight finally assembles his Round Table of young but powerful Knights, including Ben, in order to conquer all of history.
